excluded_context.metric_definition: test-set-wide pixel-level AUPRC + ideal Dice (dDicee); BraTS head-MRI tumor test set of that paper's own pipeline
excluded_context.reason: Different experimental setting (own BraTS pipeline/splits/modalities, pixel-only metrics, no image-level AUC/AP). NOT used for comparison.
excluded_context.source: DAE paper.pdf (Kascenas et al.), p.9, Table 3

BestDice.paper_definition: ⌈Dice⌉: dataset-wise best Dice at optimal test-set operating point (p.9); mapped to our BestDice (identical definition)

PixAP.paper_definition: pixel-level AP (p.9); mapped to our PixAP

citation.note: Paper explicitly excludes pixel-level AUC: 'We do not employ the pixel-level AUC since it is insensitive to false positives' (p.9).

protocol_note: Paper reports mean+-std over 3 random seeds; reproduction is single seed 0. Comparison is against published means.
